**Current**
- The experts say preseason has shown his fantasy flaws. They agree he should not be drafted in the top 100 in category leagues. One projection puts him around 180th in categories, and one speaker calls him fine around pick 120. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/OsbUAkSeVB4?t=549), [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=1193), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1948), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=1416), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=1141), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1879), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1258), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1921), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1036), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1401), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=477))
- One expert does not think he will be worth a roster spot at the start of the season. (verdict, 2026-10-09; [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1948))
- His usage will be well below his 35% in summer league. Trae Young and Anthony Davis will get the preferred touches. (verdict, 2026-10-06; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1270), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=119), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=339), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1258), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1921), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=1141), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1879), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1036), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=1416), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1271), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=355), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=2539), [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=112))
- In an auction mock, Josh valued him at 1 USD. He sold for 4 USD, which Josh called too much. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=3187))
- He is a rookie and the No. 1 overall pick. Washington is building around him as its centerpiece. (fact, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=129))
- He is projected to start at small forward. He may also play shooting guard or power forward, depending on the lineup. (fact, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=382), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=339), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=379))
- Washington may bring him along slowly. Early in the season he could play around 28 minutes a night instead of 34 or more. (verdict, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=2052))
- Washington is trying to compete and is projected to win around 40 games and reach the play-in. Late-season resting and minutes cuts should not be a factor. (verdict, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=2185), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1802))
- Head coach Brian Keefe is under heavy pressure to win this season. (fact, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1605))

**Durable**
- His projected turnovers are high for a forward. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- He is worth more in points leagues than in category leagues. Experts call his category profile the worst of the top four rookies. (verdict, 2026-10-09; [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1036), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=1141), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1948), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1401), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=797))
- Shooting is his main category weakness. His three-point volume and accuracy are poor, and he has not been a good free throw shooter. In summer league he shot 39% from the field and went 1 for 11 from three. One draft note called his shooting fine. (verdict, 2026-09-22; [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1860), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=78), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1983), [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1489), [06-22](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=205), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386))
- The experts see steals and blocks as weak for him. They say the summer league defensive stats are not his usual pattern, and he would move up if they stick. (verdict, 2026-09-10; [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1921), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=119), [08-02](https://youtu.be/TOn-D1SV7a8?t=1424))
- The experts disagree on his passing. Some call his assists very good and praise his pick and roll play for his size. Others call his passing unclear or not strong. (verdict, 2026-09-03; [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1458), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1489))
- He is a volume scorer. He gets to the rim and the free throw line at will, at about 7 free throw attempts per game in summer league, the same as at BYU. (fact, 2026-07-23; [08-02](https://youtu.be/TOn-D1SV7a8?t=1424), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=78), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1983), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386))
- In summer league he had 5 steals and 3 blocks across two games. (fact, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=119), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1983))
- Scouts at the draft flagged his defense and shot selection as concerns. They also gave him the best long-term floor in the class because of his usage, shot creation and handle. (verdict, 2026-06-23; [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1489), [06-22](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=205))
